# Friends Friend Quiz Skill

This skill runs a short, unofficial Friends friend quiz in chat, just for fun. It asks ten original questions one by one, keeps the score hidden, and names the friend who fits your answers best, with a short explanation. It is not a personality test, and it is not an official quiz.

Unofficial fan quiz. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Warner Bros. No official text, image, emblem, music, line, or quiz is copied here. All six friends are fictional characters only, never actors, never living people. Just for fun, not a real personality test.
